div.head: III Eg 6.2
div.ab: Gyf hit þyfð beo, ⁊ gyf he hine binnan twelf monðum gelangian mæge, agyfe hine to rihte, ⁊ him man agyfe þæt he ǽr sealde.
Gyf hit ðeof beo, ⁊ gif he hine binnan twelf monðum gelangian mæge, agyfe hine to rihte, ⁊ him man agyfe þæt he ær geald.
Gif hit þonne þeof beo, ⁊ gif he hine þonne binnan XII monðum gelangian mæge, agife hine to rihte, ⁊ him man agife þæt he ær geald.
Gif hit þeof beo, ⁊ gyf he hine binnan XII monðum gelangian mæge, agyfe hine to rihte, ⁊ him man agyfe þæt he ær geald.
Si latro plegiatus aufugiat, et plegius infra XII menses possit eum rehabere, reddat eum ad rectum et rehabeat quicquid ante propter hoc dederat.
Gif hit þonne þeof beo, ⁊ gif he hine þonne binnan XII monðum gelangian mæge, agife hine to rihte, ⁊ him man agife þæt he ær geald.
Gyf hit þeof beo, and gyf he hine binnan twelf monðum gelangian mæge, agyfe hine to rihte, and him man agyfe þæt he ær sealde.
Wenn es (nun D) ein Dieb(stahl G) ist, und wenn der [Bürge] ihn (dann D) binnen 12 Monaten fassen kann, liefere er ihn dem Gerichte aus, und was er zuvor bezahlt hatte, werde ihm zurückgegeben.
If it is (then, D) a thief (theft, G), and if the [surety] can (then, D) seize him within 12 months, let him deliver him up to justice, and let what he had paid before be given back to him.
If the case be that of a thief and his surety can lay hold of him within twelve months, he shall deliver him up to justice, and what he has paid shall be returned to him.
And if it is theft, and if he can lay hold of him within twelve months, he is to surrender him to justice and to be given back what he previously paid.
If the fugitive is a thief, and if the surety can capture him within twelve months, let him be surrendered to the law and let the fine which the surety had previously paid be returned to him.
div.note: G's ‘þyfð’ should be corrected to ‘þeof’ from A, D, G2 and Quadr.?

note.seg: bessere þeof aus A D G2 Quadr.? ðyfþe Ld
read þeof from A D G2 Quadr.? ðyfþe Ld

þyfð nur in gls, während Q vielmehr þeof las, scheint nicht original, wohl aber sealde, weil dieses Q's dederat vorlag. Geald (Rec. II) ändert den Sinn nicht. Hs. D setzt þonne zweimal überflüssig ein.—Diebstahl steht für diejenigen Arten des Verbrechens (s. d. Gl 1), die zu strafen der Staat für seine sittliche Aufgabe hält, im Ggs. z. B. zu unbedachter Bluttat; unten 7, 3 gewinnt der ‘Dieb’ neben dem Herrenverräter auch durch Asyl nicht Freiheit von Leibesstrafe

þyfð, found only in gls, whereas Q read þeof instead, seems not to be original; sealde, however, probably is, because it underlay Q’s dederat. Geald (Rec. II) does not alter the sense. MS D inserts þonne twice unnecessarily. — Theft stands for those kinds of crime (see that word in Gl 1) which the State considers it its moral task to punish, in contrast e.g. to unpremeditated bloodshed; below 7, 3 the ‘thief’, like the traitor to his lord, does not gain freedom from corporal punishment even by sanctuary
Später tritt für diese Frist (s. d. 19b) Jahr und Tag ein.—Bessere Übs. folg. Z. ‘ihn zum Recht(sgange) aus’
Later a year and a day takes the place of this period (see that word in Gl 19b). — Correct the translation in the next line to ‘ihn zum Recht(sgange) aus’
ðeof (A, D, G₂), cf. latro (Q), is probably the correct reading.
